_schema_notes.purpose: Static, hand-curated content library. Read by the narrative engine at runtime. No API calls happen when this is used — it is pure lookup + template assembly.
_schema_notes.actionType: Classical functional-vs-structural characterization. One of: functional, functional-to-structural, structural.
_schema_notes.systemAffinities: Ordered list, most prominent affinity first. 'system' must match a value used in CHAPTER_TO_SYSTEM (see narrative_engine.js) so rubric chapters can be matched against it.
_schema_notes.characteristicModalities: Remedy-level generals — true independent of any single rubric. Used to corroborate rubric-level modality tags.
_schema_notes.characteristicCausations: Remedy-level causation generals, same purpose as above for the Cause qualifier tag.
_schema_notes.editing_instructions: Edit pathophysiology text freely — it is inserted verbatim into generated narratives. Keep each pathophysiology string to 1-3 sentences; the engine does not summarize or trim it.

Nux-v..actionTypeNote: Predominantly a functional disturbance of nervous regulation and smooth-muscle tone; structural change is late and secondary to chronic irritative overload rather than a primary feature.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Disturbs gastric motility and sphincter tone, producing spasmodic, irritable dysfunction of the upper GI tract rather than mucosal destruction in the early stage — hyperacidity, reflux, and constrictive cramping from smooth-muscle over-tone.
Heightens reflex irritability and sensory threshold sensitivity (light, noise, odours), consistent with a state of nervous over-stimulation followed by exhaustion.
Spasmodic muscular tension and cramping, particularly of the back and abdominal wall, from the same irritable smooth/skeletal muscle over-tone pattern.

characteristicModalities: worse: morning, after eating, mental exertion, stimulants, cold
better: warmth, short sleep, hard pressure, passing stool
characteristicCausations: ailments from overwork, sedentary habits, alcohol/stimulant excess, anger, sleep deprivation
Nux-v..constitutionalNote: Classically the picture of a high-strung, driven, irritable constitution whose regulatory systems are pushed past their functional reserve by lifestyle overload.

Ars..actionTypeNote: Begins as a functional disturbance of thermoregulation and secretory control, but the picture is one of the more rapidly structural remedies when the underlying pathology is progressive (mucosal, vascular) rather than purely irritative.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Produces burning irritation of the gastric and intestinal mucosa with marked prostration disproportionate to the local finding — a picture of mucosal irritant injury with systemic exhaustion.
Anxious, constrictive dyspnea with a sense of suffocation, often worse lying flat and after midnight, reflecting both airway reactivity and the characteristic restlessness of the remedy.
Dry, scaly, burning skin changes with poor healing tendency, consistent with the remedy's general pattern of tissue dryness and depleted vital reaction.

characteristicModalities: worse: midnight to 2 AM, cold, cold drinks, exertion
better: warmth (in general, despite burning sensations), warm drinks, head elevated
characteristicCausations: ailments from food poisoning, spoiled food, debilitating illness, fear/anxiety
Ars..constitutionalNote: The picture is one of marked anxiety and restlessness out of proportion to physical strength, with fastidiousness and chilliness as constitutional markers.

Sulph..actionTypeNote: A deep-acting, structurally oriented remedy in classical usage — associated with chronic, relapsing tissue-level disturbance (skin, mucosa, circulation) rather than an acute functional derangement alone.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Chronic inflammatory skin disturbance with heat, redness, and itching worse from warmth and washing, reflecting a pattern of poor eliminative/detoxification function expressed through the skin.
Sluggish, congestive portal and intestinal circulation with morning diarrhea and a characteristic sinking, empty sensation around 11 AM.
Generalized heat intolerance and burning sensations (soles, palms, vertex) consistent with dysregulated peripheral circulation and thermoregulation.

characteristicModalities: better: dry warm weather, open air, motion
characteristicCausations: ailments from suppressed skin eruptions, suppressed discharges, neglected chronic conditions
Sulph..constitutionalNote: The classical 'philosophical ragged' constitutional picture — untidy, intellectually absorbed, with poor attention to physical self-care and a chronic, relapsing rather than acute disease pattern.

Rhus-t..actionTypeNote: Primarily a functional disturbance of connective tissue and joint mobility — stiffness and pain from disuse/rest rather than progressive structural joint destruction.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Stiffness and pain on first motion after rest, easing with continued gentle movement — a pattern consistent with reduced synovial/connective-tissue lubrication that improves once tissues are mobilized.
Vesicular, intensely itching eruptions, reflecting a reactive inflammatory skin response pattern.
Marked restlessness — an inability to stay still despite pain being worse on initial motion, reflecting a drive to relieve stiffness through continued movement.

characteristicModalities: worse: rest, initial motion, cold damp weather, night
better: continued motion, warmth, warm applications, changing position
characteristicCausations: ailments from overexertion/strain, getting wet, cold damp exposure, sprains
Rhus-t..constitutionalNote: The 'rusty hinge' picture — worse on starting to move, better once moving, restless even when in pain.

Lyc..actionTypeNote: Functional in its earlier digestive and hepatic presentation, but classically associated with progressive, right-sided-predominant organ dysfunction over time.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Sluggish hepatic and digestive function with marked bloating and gas, worse after eating even small amounts, and a characteristic 4-8 PM aggravation consistent with a circadian digestive-function pattern.
Right-sided renal/urinary complaints with a tendency toward sediment formation, reflecting the remedy's general right-sided and lithic-diathesis affinity.
A pattern of outward confidence masking underlying insecurity, alongside genuine physical depletion (weak digestion, fatigue) despite reasonable appetite.

characteristicModalities: worse: 4-8 PM, after eating, right side, warmth (in some presentations)
better: warm drinks, motion, after midnight, loosening clothing
characteristicCausations: ailments from anger with silent resentment, prolonged mental strain, poor diet habits
Lyc..constitutionalNote: Right-sided predominance and a 4-8 PM aggravation window are the two most reliable constitutional/general markers.

Puls..actionTypeNote: A functional, markedly variable disturbance — symptoms shift in location and character, consistent with a labile rather than fixed pathological pattern.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Catarrhal mucosal disturbance with thick, bland, yellow-green discharge and marked variability between dry and loose states, reflecting fluctuating mucosal secretory activity.
Variable, changeable menstrual and hormonal-pattern complaints, again reflecting the remedy's characteristic lability rather than a fixed structural lesion.
Digestive complaints from rich, fatty food with absence of thirst despite dryness — a functional intolerance pattern rather than structural mucosal damage.

characteristicModalities: worse: warm rooms, rich/fatty food, evening, lying on painless side
better: open air, gentle motion, cold applications, consolation
characteristicCausations: ailments from rich food, getting overheated, suppressed emotion, hormonal shifts
Puls..constitutionalNote: Mild, yielding, emotionally expressive constitution with symptoms that shift and change rather than remain fixed — variability itself is the constitutional signature.

Acon..actionTypeNote: A first-stage acute remedy — sudden, violent functional derangement of circulation and nervous tone with no structural change yet established; rarely indicated once a disease has settled into a subacute or chronic phase.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Produces sudden, high-tension circulatory reaction — full, hard, rapid pulse with anxious tachycardia, consistent with an acute sympathetic surge rather than any fixed cardiac lesion.
Sudden, intense fear and restlessness bordering on panic, often with a fixed conviction of impending death — a marker of acute autonomic overdrive.
Sudden dry, croupy, barking cough following abrupt cold dry wind exposure, reflecting acute reactive airway constriction rather than established inflammation.

characteristicModalities: worse: night, especially near midnight, cold dry wind, fright, warm room
characteristicCausations: ailments from fright, shock, sudden exposure to cold dry wind
Acon..constitutionalNote: The classical first-stage remedy for a full-blooded, plethoric constitution reacting violently and suddenly; the sudden onset and the specific causation (fright, cold dry wind) are more diagnostic than any single local symptom.

Apis.actionTypeNote: An acute, reactive edematous/inflammatory disturbance of fluid distribution and capillary permeability rather than a fixed structural lesion.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Rapid, rosy, stinging and burning edematous swelling, reflecting acute increased capillary permeability without proportional local heat or thirst.
Scanty urine with tendency to systemic edema, consistent with acute renal/serous membrane fluid-retention disturbance.
Marked heat intolerance with a notable absence of thirst even during fever, an unusual combination that reflects the remedy's characteristic fluid-regulation pattern.

characteristicModalities: worse: heat, warm room, touch, pressure, afternoon
better: cold applications, open air, cold bathing
characteristicCausations: ailments from insect stings, suppressed eruptions, acute allergic reactions
Apis.constitutionalNote: Restless, busy, sometimes jealous or tearful disposition, but the absence-of-thirst-with-edema physical picture is the more reliable prescribing marker than the mental generals alone.

Arn..actionTypeNote: A functional disturbance of the capillary bed and soft-tissue circulation following mechanical trauma — bruising and soreness rather than fracture or structural destruction.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Capillary injury producing a sore, bruised sensation disproportionate to any visible mark, with tenderness to the slightest touch or pressure.
A characteristic shock-state denial of injury — the patient insists nothing is wrong even when visibly hurt, reflecting acute autonomic shock response.
Fear of being touched or approached despite pain, and a restlessness that makes the bed feel too hard no matter the surface.

characteristicModalities: worse: touch, motion, damp cold, immediately after injury
characteristicCausations: ailments from trauma, injury, overexertion, mechanical strain
Arn..constitutionalNote: The classical first-aid/trauma remedy; the picture is a functional capillary and shock-response disturbance rather than structural tissue destruction, which is why it suits bruising and soft-tissue injury rather than fracture itself.

Bell..actionTypeNote: An acute hyperemic and congestive vascular disturbance — sudden, violent, and localized rather than a fixed structural lesion; classically the 'second stage' of acute inflammatory fever once local congestion is established.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Sudden, intense throbbing congestive states with marked hypersensitivity to light, noise, and jarring, reflecting acute cerebral vascular engorgement.
Flushed face with radiant heat and a bounding pulse, consistent with acute peripheral vasodilation and hyperemia.
High fever with delirium, glassy eyes, and dilated pupils — a picture of acute, violent-onset congestive fever rather than a slow-building one.

characteristicModalities: worse: light, noise, jarring, touch, lying down, 3 PM
better: semi-erect position, warmth, firm pressure on the head
characteristicCausations: ailments from sun exposure, suppressed perspiration, getting the head wet
Bell..constitutionalNote: Suits a plethoric, full-blooded constitution reacting with sudden violent hyperemia; the suddenness and violence of onset, more than any specific organ, is the prescribing signature.

Bry..actionTypeNote: A serous-membrane inflammatory disturbance in which the single most reliable general — aggravation from the slightest motion — is more diagnostic than any local organ finding.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Stitching pains sharply aggravated by even the slightest motion and dramatically relieved by absolute rest and firm pressure, consistent with serous-membrane (pleural, peritoneal, synovial) inflammation.
Marked dryness of mucosa with thirst for large quantities at long intervals, and constipation with dry, hard stool — a pattern of reduced secretory fluid rather than structural obstruction.
Dry, painful cough worse on the slightest movement or deep breath, again reflecting pleural/serous membrane irritation aggravated mechanically.

characteristicModalities: worse: motion (even the slightest), morning, warm room, exertion
better: absolute rest, firm pressure, lying on the painful side, cold applications
characteristicCausations: ailments from getting overheated then chilled, suppressed anger, dietetic errors
Bry..constitutionalNote: Irritable and wants to be left entirely still and undisturbed, in direct contrast to Rhus-t., which is worse at rest and better from continued motion — this contrast is the key differential between the two remedies.

Calc..actionTypeNote: A deep, slow-acting constitutional remedy for chronic under-function of metabolism and tissue nutrition, better suited to intercurrent/constitutional prescribing than acute use.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Slow metabolic and nutritive disturbance with a tendency to obesity or poor assimilation, and profuse sour-smelling perspiration of the head and scalp during sleep.
Delayed ossification and weak bones or joints in growing individuals, with a tendency toward glandular and lymphatic swelling.
Sour, curdled-milk-smelling stool or vomiting, with an aversion to meat and a characteristic craving for eggs or indigestible substances.

characteristicModalities: worse: cold, damp, exertion, ascending stairs
better: dry warm weather, lying on the painful side
characteristicCausations: ailments from vaccination, overexertion during growth, chronic exhausting illness
Calc..constitutionalNote: The classical fair, fat, flabby, chilly, sluggish constitutional picture (though not universal) for slow, chronic tissue-level under-function — a foundational deep-acting remedy rather than a first-line acute one.

Cham..actionTypeNote: A heightened nervous-system pain-sensitivity disturbance, classically prominent during teething or colic, where pain intolerance itself is more diagnostic than any specific local complaint.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Extreme intolerance to pain with irritability disproportionate to the actual complaint, a hallmark during teething or acute colic.
Colicky abdominal pain with green, offensive diarrhea, particularly in infants, consistent with acute intestinal irritability.
One cheek flushed red and the other pale during fever or teething, reflecting an asymmetric acute vascular reaction.

characteristicCausations: ailments from anger with indignation, teething, coffee
Cham..constitutionalNote: Classic for the inconsolable child (or adult) who wants to be carried and rejects everything offered — pain intolerance and inconsolable irritability are the reliable generals, more than any single local complaint.

Chin..actionTypeNote: A functional debility state following loss of vital fluids — blood, sweat, or other discharges — with a characteristic periodicity to complaints.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Marked debility following hemorrhage, prolonged lactation, or exhausting diarrhea, with complaints often recurring on an every-other-day periodic pattern.
Bloating unrelieved by belching or passing gas, worse after eating, reflecting sluggish digestive motility from fluid-loss debility.
Ringing in the ears and mental dullness consistent with exhaustion-related nervous under-function.

characteristicModalities: worse: every other day (periodicity), after loss of fluids, touch (in neuralgia), during digestion
characteristicCausations: ailments from loss of vital fluids, hemorrhage, prolonged lactation, debilitating diarrhea
Chin..constitutionalNote: The every-other-day periodicity together with flatulent bloating unrelieved by any usual measure are the two most reliable distinguishing markers for this remedy.

Coloc..actionTypeNote: A severe spasmodic visceral pain disturbance, frequently triggered or worsened by suppressed anger or indignation.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Violent, cutting abdominal cramping that forces the patient to bend double, dramatically relieved by hard pressure — a pattern of acute smooth-muscle spasm rather than structural obstruction.
Pain onset or aggravation directly following episodes of anger or suppressed indignation, reflecting an emotion-triggered neuromuscular spasm pattern.
Neuralgic pain along nerve distributions, again characteristically relieved by firm pressure.

characteristicModalities: worse: anger, indignation, eating, even small amounts of food
better: hard pressure, bending double, warmth
characteristicCausations: ailments from anger with indignation (especially suppressed), grief
Coloc..constitutionalNote: The bending-double, pressure-seeking spasmodic pain picture is diagnostic on its own, and is strongly corroborated when there is a clear history of anger or indignation preceding onset.

Gels..actionTypeNote: A functional motor and neuromuscular weakness disturbance, classically associated with anticipatory anxiety (the 'exam-fear' picture) rather than any structural neurological lesion.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Heavy, drooping eyelids with muscular weakness, trembling, and drowsiness, reflecting a functional reduction in motor tone and alertness.
A slow, weak pulse in some presentations, consistent with reduced autonomic and motor drive.
Anticipatory anxiety before an event (an exam, a performance) producing trembling and sudden diarrhea, without the sharp panic of Aconitum.

characteristicModalities: worse: anticipation, emotion, damp weather, before a thunderstorm, bad news
better: motion once started, open air, urination, stimulants
characteristicCausations: ailments from fright without excitement, anticipation or dread, sudden bad news
Gels..constitutionalNote: The classical 'exam-fear' remedy — trembling, weak, drowsy, wanting to be quiet, notably without thirst even during fever, distinguishing it from the more violent Belladonna/Aconitum picture.

Graph..actionTypeNote: A deep, slow-acting remedy for chronic skin, glandular, and scar-tissue dysfunction, with a tendency toward poor healing rather than a purely functional or acute disturbance.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Dry or oozing, honey-like sticky eruptions especially in skin folds, with a marked tendency toward keloid or excessive scar-tissue formation.
Constipation with large, difficult, knotty stool, reflecting sluggish bowel tone consistent with the remedy's general slow metabolic pattern.
Scanty, delayed menses alongside a tendency to obesity, consistent with a broader hormonal-metabolic under-function pattern.

characteristicModalities: worse: warmth of bed, during menses, night
better: in the dark, wrapping up warmly
characteristicCausations: ailments from suppressed skin eruptions, obesity-related hormonal disturbance
Graph..constitutionalNote: A chilly, obese, constipated constitution with a characteristic sticky honey-like skin discharge and a history of poor scar healing — a genuinely structural, slow-acting remedy rather than an acute one.

Hep..actionTypeNote: Bridges functional irritability toward actual suppurative structural change — the hallmark is that minor injuries or inflammations in this constitution tend to progress to pus formation rather than resolve cleanly.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Extreme sensitivity to touch and cold air over any inflamed area, with a marked tendency for every minor wound to suppurate.
Croupy, rattling cough worse from any cold air exposure, with splinter-like throat pain reflecting acute mucosal hypersensitivity.
Extreme irritability paired with oversensitivity to both pain and cold in general, more marked than in most other remedies.

characteristicModalities: worse: cold air, dry cold, touch, uncovering
better: warmth, wrapping up, humid weather
characteristicCausations: ailments from suppressed suppuration, exposure to cold dry air
Hep..constitutionalNote: The combined hypersensitivity to pain and to cold, together with a tendency of small wounds to suppurate, marks this remedy's transitional role between purely functional irritability and structural suppurative change.

Ign..actionTypeNote: An acute grief and emotional-shock disturbance producing a characteristically contradictory, paradoxical symptom picture rather than a fixed, textbook-consistent one.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Rapidly alternating mood and symptoms, a spasmodic globus sensation (lump in the throat), and involuntary sighing or weeping, reflecting acute emotional-nervous dysregulation.
Paradoxical digestive complaints — for instance, symptoms sometimes easing rather than worsening after eating, a pattern uncharacteristic of typical dyspeptic remedies.
A generally contradictory, changeable symptom picture that doesn't fit conventional clinical patterns, itself a marker of the remedy's characteristic paradox.

characteristicModalities: worse: grief, emotional shock, consolation (unlike Pulsatilla), coffee, tobacco smoke
better: swallowing (eases the globus sensation), change of position, warmth
characteristicCausations: ailments from acute grief, disappointment in love, emotional shock, silent grief
Ign..constitutionalNote: The acute-grief remedy — contradictory, paradoxical symptoms (improving from what should worsen them) are themselves the prescribing signature, more than any single fixed complaint.

Kali-c..actionTypeNote: A deep constitutional remedy reflecting cardiovascular and musculoskeletal exhaustion in a rigid, dutiful, anxious constitution, rather than an acute functional derangement.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Weakness and stitching pain of the back, particularly the lower back, markedly worse from any exertion.
Weak, anxious heart symptoms worse lying on the left side, with a characteristic swelling of the upper eyelids as an external marker.
Marked chilliness with a distinctive 2-4 AM aggravation window, consistent with disrupted circadian regulation of vital tone.

characteristicModalities: worse: 2-4 AM, cold, lying on the left or painful side, exertion
characteristicCausations: ailments from prolonged grief, overwork, exhausting illness, childbirth
Kali-c..constitutionalNote: A rigid, punctual, anxious constitution with marked chilliness; the stitching lower-back pain and swollen upper eyelids are the classic external markers.

Merc..actionTypeNote: A deep, ulcerative, tissue-destructive remedy in which profuse secretions fail to relieve the underlying complaint — distinguishing it from more purely functional remedies.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Profuse, offensive salivation with foul breath and a swollen tongue taking the imprint of the teeth, reflecting an ulcerative tendency of oral mucosa.
Offensive perspiration that does not relieve the complaint, alongside glandular swelling, consistent with a deep secretory-tissue disturbance.
Marked sensitivity to both heat and cold, worse at night, reflecting a broad dysregulation of thermoregulatory tone.

characteristicModalities: worse: night, warmth of bed, extremes of temperature, perspiring
characteristicCausations: ailments from suppressed discharges, exposure to damp cold
Merc..constitutionalNote: Profuse, offensive secretions (saliva, sweat, discharges) that fail to relieve the underlying complaint are the hallmark of this deep, destructive, ulcerative tissue-level remedy.

Nat-m..actionTypeNote: A chronic fluid-balance and emotional-suppression pattern — grief present but never expressed outwardly — producing mucosal and nutritive disturbance over time.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Craving for salt with marked thirst, and emaciation despite a good appetite, especially noticeable around the neck, alongside intolerance of consolation or sympathy.
Headaches described as like small hammers, worse from sun exposure between 9 and 11 AM, reflecting a photosensitive vascular-nervous pattern.
Oily skin especially along the hairline, and a tendency to cold-sore or herpetic eruptions, consistent with the remedy's general mucocutaneous disturbance.

characteristicModalities: worse: consolation, sun exposure (9-11 AM), heat, grief
better: open air, cold bathing, lying on the right side
characteristicCausations: ailments from silent, unexpressed grief, disappointment, long-suppressed emotional injury
Nat-m..constitutionalNote: The 'silent grief' constitutional remedy — grief is present but never expressed, unlike Ignatia's acute expressive grief — producing chronic fluid-balance and mucosal disturbance over time.

Nit-ac..actionTypeNote: An ulcerative, mucocutaneous-junction pathology with a chilly, irritable, vindictive constitutional overlay.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Splinter-like, sharp pains particularly at mucocutaneous junctions such as the anus and corners of the mouth, with ulcerative lesions carrying a foul odor.
Strongly offensive urine odor even when the quantity passed is small, consistent with a marked secretory-odor disturbance.
Marked chilliness alongside an irritable, vindictive disposition, corroborating the remedy's generally destructive tissue picture.

characteristicModalities: worse: touch, cold, at mucocutaneous junctions, jarring
better: warmth, lying down, supported motion
characteristicCausations: ailments from suppressed discharge conditions, prolonged illness affecting mucous membranes
Nit-ac..constitutionalNote: Splinter-like pain specifically at mucocutaneous junctions is the single most reliable distinguishing local marker for this remedy.

Nux-m..actionTypeNote: A marked disturbance of secretory dryness and alertness regulation — reversible and functional rather than structural.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Extreme drowsiness with a tendency to fall asleep even mid-activity, and disorientation about time or place, reflecting a functional reduction in cortical alertness.
Extreme dryness of the mouth without any accompanying thirst, and bloating after even small meals, consistent with reduced secretory and motor gut function.
A tendency to faint, especially in warm rooms, reflecting labile autonomic regulation.

characteristicModalities: worse: cold, damp weather, warm rooms (for the fainting tendency), during menses
better: warmth (for digestive symptoms), open air (for faintness)
characteristicCausations: ailments from cold damp exposure, exhaustion
Nux-m..constitutionalNote: Extreme dryness of all mucous membranes combined with marked drowsiness is the distinguishing marker — a functional, reversible disturbance of secretory and alertness regulation.

Phos..actionTypeNote: A tall, slender, sensitive constitution with a marked hemorrhagic tendency and dramatic emotional openness — one of the more rapidly structural remedies once chronic organ change (respiratory, hepatic) becomes established.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Tightness and burning in the chest with hoarseness and an easy tendency to mucosal bleeding, reflecting heightened vascular fragility.
A desire for cold drinks or food which is vomited once it warms in the stomach, alongside a craving for salty or spicy food.
Marked fear — of thunderstorms, being alone, or death — paired with an open, sociable, sympathetic disposition.

characteristicModalities: worse: lying on the left side, twilight/dusk, thunderstorms, cold changing to warm
better: cold food/drinks initially, dark, company, sleep
characteristicCausations: ailments from fright, loss of fluids, overwork of the nervous system
Phos..constitutionalNote: The hemorrhagic tendency and dramatic emotional openness mark a constitution that begins functionally but becomes genuinely structural once chronic organ-level change sets in.

Sep..actionTypeNote: A chronic hormonal and circulatory sluggishness pattern, especially affecting the female reproductive axis, with marked emotional indifference uncharacteristic of the person's normal disposition.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: A bearing-down sensation as if the pelvic organs would fall out, with irregular or scanty menses, reflecting reduced pelvic tone and hormonal regulation.
Nausea at the smell or thought of food, and a sinking, empty sensation not relieved by eating, consistent with disrupted appetite-satiety regulation.
Yellow-brown pigmentation across the nose and cheeks, with marked fatigue that is characteristically relieved by vigorous exercise.

characteristicModalities: worse: before menses, morning, cold air, standing
better: vigorous exercise, warmth, pressure, hot applications
characteristicCausations: ailments from hormonal exhaustion (childbirth, prolonged lactation, menopause), suppressed emotion
Sep..constitutionalNote: The bearing-down sensation combined with marked emotional indifference toward family or loved ones — uncharacteristic of the person's usual disposition — is the classic prescribing signature.

Sil..actionTypeNote: A deep nutritive remedy for a constitution whose tissues fail to heal or expel foreign matter properly — the classical 'splinter remedy' for incomplete suppurative or inflammatory processes.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Weak nails and hair with a tendency toward slow-healing wounds and fistula formation, reflecting deficient tissue nutrition.
Profuse, offensive foot sweat alongside a tendency for every small wound to suppurate, similar to but more chronic than Hepar.
Lack of stamina and mental exhaustion from even slight effort, paired with marked chilliness.

characteristicModalities: better: warmth, wrapping the head, summer
characteristicCausations: ailments from vaccination, suppressed foot sweat, malnutrition, chronic suppuration
Sil..constitutionalNote: A deep-acting nutritive remedy where the body cannot complete an inflammatory or suppurative process on its own — the classical indication for chronic fistula or retained foreign material.

Staph..actionTypeNote: The 'wounded dignity' remedy — effects of suppressed anger or humiliation, where the causation is often more diagnostic than the local complaint itself.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Effects of suppressed anger or humiliation, with marked sensitivity to insult or rudeness, and characteristic sequelae following surgical incision.
Cystitis-like symptoms particularly following intercourse or emotional violation, reflecting a psychosomatic urogenital irritability pattern.
Clean-cut, sharp pain as if from a knife, especially in the post-surgical setting.

characteristicModalities: worse: suppressed anger or indignation, touch, sexual excess
characteristicCausations: ailments from humiliation, suppressed anger, violation of personal dignity, surgery
Staph..constitutionalNote: The specific causation — a discrete incident of humiliation, violation, or suppressed indignation — is often more diagnostic than the local complaint itself.

Thuj..actionTypeNote: The classical antisycotic remedy for a constitution given to new-growth formation, with fixed, obsessive mental patterns — a genuinely structural, tissue-proliferative picture rather than a purely functional one.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Warty, cauliflower-like growths and oily skin, reflecting a tendency toward benign tissue proliferation.
A history of urethral discharge, corresponding to the classical sycotic-miasm picture in traditional homeopathic theory.
Fixed ideas — for instance, a sensation of fragility as if made of glass — reflecting an obsessive, rigid thought-pattern disturbance.

characteristicModalities: worse: 3 AM and 3 PM, damp cold, after vaccination, onions
better: drawing up the affected limb, warmth, sweating
characteristicCausations: ailments from vaccination, suppressed genital discharge, overuse of green tea
Thuj..constitutionalNote: A constitution given to new-growth formation (warts, polyps) alongside fixed, obsessive mental patterns — a genuinely structural, tissue-proliferative picture.

Verat..actionTypeNote: A collapse-state remedy — violent purging with sudden prostration — where cold sweat on the forehead is the single most reliable marker.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Violent vomiting and purging occurring simultaneously, producing rapid collapse with profuse watery diarrhea.
Cold sweat on the forehead especially during exertion or pain, with a weak, thready pulse in collapse states.
Restlessness alternating with prostration, occasionally with manic features in acute presentations.

characteristicModalities: better: warmth, walking about (in the restless phase), lying quiet (in the collapse phase)
characteristicCausations: ailments from fright, ice-cold drinks in summer, exhausting purging illness
Verat..constitutionalNote: Cold sweat on the forehead during violent purging or vomiting is the single most reliable marker, distinguishing this from other purging remedies by the degree and suddenness of prostration.

Con..actionTypeNote: A progressive glandular-induration and ascending-paralysis pattern — the hardening of glandular tissue combined with ascending numbness is the classical distinguishing structural signature.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Indurated, hardened glandular swelling, particularly of the breast or testicular tissue, in the classical Materia Medica picture.
An ascending numbness or paralysis pattern, with vertigo worse on turning the head or lying down.
Weakness with trembling, particularly after exertion, consistent with progressive neuromuscular involvement.

characteristicModalities: worse: lying down, turning in bed, alcohol, either enforced celibacy or sexual excess
characteristicCausations: ailments from suppressed sexual desire, injuries to glandular tissue, grief
Con..constitutionalNote: Progressive hardening of glandular tissue combined with an ascending numbness/paralysis pattern is the classical distinguishing structural signature for this remedy.

Arg-n..actionTypeNote: An anticipatory-anxiety disturbance marked by hurried impulsiveness and rushing to conclusions, distinguishing it from the trembling weakness of Gelsemium's anticipatory picture.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Anticipatory anxiety producing hurried, impulsive behavior, fear of heights and crowds, and an inability to wait calmly for anything.
Belching and bloating with an intense craving for sweets that consistently aggravates the digestive complaints.
A premature-aging appearance with an internal trembling sensation, reflecting chronic nervous-system overdrive.

characteristicModalities: worse: warmth, sweets, mental exertion, crowds, heights
better: cold air, cold applications, pressure
characteristicCausations: ailments from anticipation, mental overwork
Arg-n..constitutionalNote: Hurried, impulsive, and prematurely aged in appearance; anticipatory anxiety expressed as rushing and impulsiveness, rather than paralysis, distinguishes this remedy from Gelsemium.

Ars-i..actionTypeNote: Combines Arsenicum's restless, burning irritation with Iodum's wasting and glandular overactivity, chiefly expressed through the respiratory tract and skin.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Profuse, excoriating nasal and bronchial catarrh with wheezing, and a tendency toward recurrent sinusitis.
Dry, scaly eruptions with intense itching that is markedly worse from warmth.
Marked emaciation despite adequate food intake, alongside general restlessness.

characteristicCausations: ailments from chronic catarrhal states, an allergic constitutional diathesis
Ars-i..constitutionalNote: A restless, wasting, allergic-diathesis constitution merging Arsenicum's anxious burning irritation with Iodum's glandular and metabolic overactivity.

Bar-c..actionTypeNote: A deep constitutional remedy occupying two poles — delayed development in children and degenerative decline in the elderly — connected by timidity and glandular involvement.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: Delayed mental development in children, or degenerative mental decline in the elderly, accompanied by marked timidity and shyness.
Enlarged tonsils and glands with delayed physical growth in the child presentation.
An arteriosclerotic tendency characteristic of the elderly-decline presentation of this remedy.

characteristicCausations: ailments from developmental delay, degenerative processes of aging
Bar-c..constitutionalNote: The two poles of this remedy — the undeveloped child or the degenerating elder — share timidity, glandular involvement, and slowed function as the connecting thread.

Bor..actionTypeNote: A functional nervous hypersensitivity disturbance with an unusual and highly specific fear of downward motion.

systemAffinities.pathophysiology: A marked fear of downward motion — being rocked downward, descending stairs — together with extreme sensitivity to sudden noise, especially in infants.
Aphthous ulcers of the mouth in infants, worse during nursing.
Moist eruptions localized to skin folds.
